.evWrap p, .evWrap ul, .evWrap ol, .evWrap li, .evWrap h3 {margin:0; padding:0; list-style:none;}
._evt_hide {position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; margin:0; clip:rect(0,0,0,0); white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden;}
._pick ._tit {left:0; width:100%; font-family:'Playfair Display', serif; font-size:9.6vw; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-0.192vw; line-height:12.8vw; text-align:center; color:#214C67;}
._pick ._deco {font-family:'Cormorant', serif; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0; line-height:normal; color:#3E4F5B; opacity:0.5; white-space:nowrap; writing-mode:vertical-rl;}

._pick ._tag ._pill {display:flex; align-items:center; height:6.4vw; padding:1.6vw 2.66667vw; border-radius:8vw; font-size:2.66667vw; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-0.08vw; line-height:normal; white-space:nowrap;}
._pick ._tag ._ico {display:flex; flex:0 0 auto; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:6.4vw; height:6.4vw; border-radius:50%;}
._pick ._tag ._name {font-size:3.33333vw; font-weight:400; letter-spacing:0; line-height:4.66667vw; white-space:nowrap; text-align:center; color:#fff;}
._best ._tit {font-family:'Playfair Display', serif; font-size:9.6vw; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-0.288vw; line-height:12.8vw; text-align:center; color:#214C67;}

._best ._cate_tit {display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:1.33333vw; height:6.4vw; font-size:5.33333vw; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-0.16vw; line-height:6.4vw; color:#161616;}
._best ._item ._thumb {display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:41.33333vw; height:41.33333vw; background-color:#E5E5E5; overflow:hidden;}

._best ._item ._desc {display:-webkit-box; min-height:8vw; margin-top:1.06667vw; -webkit-box-orient:vertical; -webkit-line-clamp:2; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; font-size:3.33333vw; font-weight:400; letter-spacing:-0.1vw; line-height:4vw;}
._best ._item ._price {display:flex; align-items:center; gap:0.8vw; margin-top:2vw; font-size:3.46667vw; line-height:4.13333vw; letter-spacing:0;}

._event ._gift ._box ._badge {position:absolute; left:2vw; top:2vw; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:10.66667vw; height:10.66667vw; border-radius:50%; background-color:#DD153E; font-family:Avenir, Pretendard, sans-serif; font-size:2.4vw; font-weight:400; line-height:2.66667vw; letter-spacing:-0.024vw; text-align:center; color:#fff;}
._event ._notice {margin-top:9.33333vw; font-family:Inter, Pretendard, sans-serif; font-size:3.33333vw; font-weight:400; line-height:normal; text-align:center; color:#A6B0B6;}

._event ._more {display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:100%; height:14.66667vw; margin-top:9.33333vw; padding:0 2.66667vw; background-color:#05446D; font-size:4vw; font-weight:400; line-height:normal; letter-spacing:0; text-align:center; color:#fff;}
